faq.q: What is the difference between HEX and RGB color formats?
faq.a: HEX uses hexadecimal notation (#RRGGBB) with values 00-FF, while RGB uses decimal values (0-255) for red, green, and blue channels. Both represent identical colors but in different numerical systems. Our HEX to RGB converter handles both formats seamlessly.

faq.q: Why do web developers prefer HEX color codes?
faq.a: HEX codes are compact, universally supported in CSS, and easy to copy/paste. They're the standard format for web colors, supported by all browsers, and require less code space than RGB values in stylesheets.

faq.q: Can I convert colors with transparency using this tool?
faq.a: Standard 6-digit HEX codes don't support transparency. For transparency, use RGBA format (rgba(255,0,0,0.5)) or 8-digit HEX codes (#RRGGBBAA) where the last two digits represent alpha transparency.

faq.q: How accurate are the HEX to RGB conversions?
faq.a: Our converter provides mathematically precise conversions between HEX and RGB formats, ensuring exact color matching across different representation systems. The conversion is lossless and maintains perfect color fidelity.

faq.q: How do I convert #FF5733 to RGB values?
faq.a: #FF5733 converts to RGB(255, 87, 51). The HEX pairs FF=255, 57=87, 33=51 in decimal. Our converter automates this calculation instantly for any HEX color code.

faq.q: What's the RGB equivalent of common HEX colors?
faq.a: Common conversions: #FFFFFF = RGB(255,255,255) white, #000000 = RGB(0,0,0) black, #FF0000 = RGB(255,0,0) red, #00FF00 = RGB(0,255,0) green, #0000FF = RGB(0,0,255) blue.
